# mtx-decompressor

Version 1.8.0, MPL-2.0; original project https://github.com/ChristopherVR/mtx-decompressor . The bundled unmodified `index.mjs` comes from the npm tarball `mtx-decompressor-1.8.0.tgz`, npm SHA-1 `b0246b2525a5d424531dbf73329bc58b54da7dc5`. GitHub source inspected at commit `9e04a5e2030a541ce4112a6bea357ad8e3094127`; package/source correspondence is not independently certified. The package is a TypeScript port of libeot. License text is in LICENSE. Font files themselves are not included.
